CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  November 17, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:03 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson

  Absent:  Mojarro, Garcia

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Planning Manager; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Avery
  Talli, Assistant Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Joaquin
  Vasquez, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – OCTOBER 20, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the October 20, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the October 20, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – SEPTEMBER 7, 2021
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the September 7, 2021, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the September 7, 2021, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  MINUTES – AUGUST 16, 2021
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the August 16, 2021, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the August 16, 2021, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  1
  11/17/2025
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1, 2, and 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro, Garcia

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no discussion items.

F.  RE-ORDER THE AGENDA:

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to reorder the Agenda, addressing Agenda Item 5 before
  Agenda Item 4.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro, Garcia

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-25-03
  • 2121 Orange Street, Unit C
  • Applicant: Leonid Burlo
  • This is a request to establish a 3,095 square-foot dance studio,
  known as ‘Fred Astaire Dance Studios of Alhambra’ within an
  existing 1-story, 17,908 square foot office building, located at
  2121 Orange Street, Unit C within the I (Industrial) zone.
  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-08, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-25-03 to establish a dance studio
  within a 3,095 square foot unit of an office building, located in the
  Industrial (I) zone, located at 2121 Orange Street, Unit C within
  the Industrial (I) zone, and finding Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  25-03 exempt from review under the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to California Environmental Quality
  Act, Section 15301 of the CEQA Guidelines, Existing Facilities,
  Class 1.
  • Assistant Planner Avery Talli provided the Staff presentation.
  • Leonid Burlo, the Applicant/Business Owner, provided the
  Applicant presentation and was available to answer questions.
  2
  11/17/2025
   •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 5.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro, Garcia

•  Commissioner Gardea left at 7:18 p.m.

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-25-01
  • 2718 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Chueling Au
  • This is a request for an existing restaurant, known as ‘Hengry,’ to
  upgrade from a Type 41 ABC license (beer and wine only) to a
  Type 47 ABC license, which would allow the sale of beer, wine,
  and distilled spirits for on-site consumption with full meal service.
  The subject site is located at 2718 West Valley Boulevard within
  the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-07, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-25-01 to allow a Type 47 (On-Sale
  General – Eating Place) ABC (Alcoholic Beverage Control)
  license permitting the sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for
  consumption on the premises in conjunction with full meal service
  at an existing restaurant, located at 2718 West Valley Boulevard
  within the CMU (Commercial Mixed Use) zone, and finding
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-25-01 exempt from review under the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to
  California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15301 of the CEQA
  Guidelines, Existing Facilities, Class 1.
  • Assistant Planner Avery Talli provided the Staff presentation.
  • Chueling Au, the Applicant/Business Owner, provided the
  Applicant presentation and was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-1-2
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Gardea
  Absent:  Mojarro, Garcia

 H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

  December 15, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.
